/-- Helper lemma: Index shift for first product -/

lemma prod_first_part (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 n, ((k : ℝ) - 1) / (k : ℝ) = 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
  induction' hn with n hn IH
  · norm_num [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top]
  · cases n with
    | zero => contradiction
    | succ n =>
      simp_all [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      field_simp at *
      ring_nf at *
      nlinarith

/-- Helper lemma: Index shift for second product -/

lemma prod_second_part (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∏ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 n, ((k : ℝ) + 1) / (k : ℝ) = ((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2 := by
  -- Approach 1: Direct induction on n
  induction' hn with n hn IH
  · norm_num [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top]
  · cases n with
      | zero => contradiction
      | succ n =>
        simp_all [Finset.prod_Icc_succ_top]
        field_simp at *
        ring_nf at *
        norm_num at *
        linarith
